reason: No patched release exists: the advisory covers every version up to 4.0.7, the latest picomatch, and the upstream fixes are still open pull requests. The ReDoS needs a glob pattern with repeated extglobs; picomatch only compiles patterns we author (Astro content loaders, asset and cache config, Vite and Vercel build tooling, semantic-release), none of which use extglobs. Kept to one week so the entry is re-checked as soon as a fix ships.
